# Templates

How every page is assembled, styled and given behaviour. Read in this
order:

- [Template placement](placement.md) — the four kinds of template, the
  overrides contract, and the cotton loader configuration.
- [Layouts](layouts.md) — `base.html` and the four frames that extend it,
  including the `api()` helper and the table of contents.
- [Design-system primitives](primitives.md) — the root cotton components,
  static and behavioural, and the tests that force their documentation.
- [Theming](theming.md) — the semantic tokens, the `.content` prose
  contract, and the rebrand checklist.
- [The script bundle](script-bundle.md) — `{% script %}`, the collector,
  and the collision checks.
- [CSP and Alpine](csp.md) — the policy, the CSP build, and the directive
  grammar.
